description: Redux Toolkit slice for managing course data with async thunks, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting courses, with normalization and selectors.

methods.name: fetchCourses
methods.description: Async thunk to fetch all courses, supports array or object with items.

methods.name: fetchCoursesQuery
methods.description: Async thunk to fetch courses with query parameters like category, q, limit, page.

methods.name: fetchCourseById
methods.description: Async thunk to fetch a single course by its ID.

methods.name: createCourse
methods.description: Async thunk to create a new course with provided payload.

methods.name: updateCourse
methods.description: Async thunk to update an existing course with provided payload.

methods.name: deleteCourse
methods.description: Async thunk to delete a course by ID.
